lines.speaker: caller
lines.ne: बिहानदेखि इन्टरनेट छैन। म बानेश्वरमा छु।
lines.text: My internet has been down since this morning. I'm in Baneshwor.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.ne: माफ गर्नुहोला। बानेश्वरको केही भागमा फाइबर काटिएको छ। हाम्रो टोली त्यहीँ छ, अपराह्न चार बजेसम्म सेवा फर्किन्छ।
lines.text: Sorry about that. A fibre cut is affecting part of Baneshwor. Our team is on site, and service should be back by four this afternoon.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Can you call me when it's fixed?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.ne: हुन्छ। तपाईंको खातामा टिकट खोलेर कलब्याक राखेँ। लाइन फर्किनेबित्तिकै फोन र एसएमएस आउँछ।
lines.text: Yes. I've opened a ticket on your account with a callback. You'll get a call and an SMS as soon as your line is back.
